# HECAVEX Labs

> Evidence-led public intelligence workspaces and bounded static datasets.

Labs publishes selected, inspectable research interfaces. It is not a live incident feed, a coverage claim, or an automated attribution system. Follow the scope, freshness, provenance, licence, and limitation fields attached to each dataset. Only files named by the public manifest are intended for distribution.

## Workspaces

- [Baltic Threat Atlas](https://labs.hecavex.com/baltic-threat-atlas/): Selected public-source observations concerning Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia.
- [Evidence Pivot](https://labs.hecavex.com/pivot-graph/): Case graphs separating observations, derivations, assessments, and limits.
- [ATT&CK Evidence](https://labs.hecavex.com/attack-map/): HECAVEX-reviewed, source-linked behavior mappings generated from published APT Notes evidence.

## Data and governance

- [HECAVEX Data](https://hecavex.com/data/): Human-readable portfolio-wide public dataset index.
- [Machine-readable catalogue](https://labs.hecavex.com/data/catalogue.json): Dataset URLs, owners, schemas, review dates, and limitations.
- [Public manifest](https://labs.hecavex.com/data/public-manifest.json): Default-deny list of files approved for publication.
- [Changes](https://labs.hecavex.com/changes/): Meaningful dataset, schema, correction, archive, and publication-boundary changes.
- [Methodology](https://labs.hecavex.com/methodology/): Evidence, transformation, confidence, and publication boundaries.
- [About](https://labs.hecavex.com/about/): Product purpose, ownership, audience, maintenance, privacy, and limitations.
- [Licence](https://labs.hecavex.com/licence/): HECAVEX and third-party rights boundaries.
- [Sitemap](https://labs.hecavex.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical workspace routes.

## Archived resources

- [OSINT Workbench archive](https://labs.hecavex.com/osint-workbench/): A dated compatibility page and historical resource snapshot. It is not maintained as a current tools directory.
